## History

Seven years prior, Mrs. Spencer brought [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) over from Hopetown on a boat. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited Mrs. Spencer to clarify an adoption mix-up after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was mistakenly sent to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of a boy.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v3 ch.Farewell P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007)_

## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

Mrs. Spencer is the parent of [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md). Her daughter is mentioned alongside her during the time [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. Spencer to address the adoption mix-up.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), +2 more_
